lemma rsum_bound:
  assumes p: "p tagged_division_of (cbox a b)"
      and "\<forall>x\<in>cbox a b. norm (f x) \<le> e"
    shows "norm (\<Sum>(x, k)\<in>p. content k *\<^sub>R f x) \<le> e * content (cbox a b)"

proof -
  have fin: "finite p"
    using p
    sledgehammer
  have tag: "\<And>x k. (x, k) \<in> p \<Longrightarrow> x \<in> cbox a b"
    using p
    sledgehammer

  show ?thesis
  proof (cases "cbox a b = {}")
    case True
    have "p = {}"
      using tag True
      sledgehammer
    then show ?thesis
      using True by simp
  next
    case False
    have e_nonneg: "0 \<le> e"
      using False assms(2)
      sledgehammer
    have term_bound:
      "\<And>x k. (x, k) \<in> p \<Longrightarrow>
        norm (content k *\<^sub>R f x) \<le> e * content k"
      using tag assms(2) content_pos_le
      sledgehammer
    have triangle:
      "norm (\<Sum>(x, k)\<in>p. content k *\<^sub>R f x)
        \<le> (\<Sum>(x, k)\<in>p. norm (content k *\<^sub>R f x))"
      using fin
      sledgehammer
    have sum_bound:
      "(\<Sum>(x, k)\<in>p. norm (content k *\<^sub>R f x))
        \<le> (\<Sum>(x, k)\<in>p. e * content k)"
      using fin term_bound
      sledgehammer
    have contents:
      "(\<Sum>(x, k)\<in>p. content k) = content (cbox a b)"
      using p by (rule additive_content_tagged_division)
    have sum_contents:
      "(\<Sum>(x, k)\<in>p. e * content k) = e * content (cbox a b)"
      using contents
      sledgehammer
    show ?thesis
      using triangle sum_bound sum_contents by linarith
  qed
qed

result.formal_statement:
lemma rsum_bound:
  assumes p: "p tagged_division_of (cbox a b)"
      and "\<forall>x\<in>cbox a b. norm (f x) \<le> e"
    shows "norm (\<Sum>(x, k)\<in>p. content k *\<^sub>R f x) \<le> e * content (cbox a b)"
result.isabelle_sketch:
proof -
  have fin: "finite p"
    using p
    sledgehammer

  have tag_in: "\<And>x k. (x,k) \<in> p \<Longrightarrow> x \<in> cbox a b"
    using p
    sledgehammer

  have term_bound:
    "\<And>x k. (x,k) \<in> p \<Longrightarrow>
      norm (content k *\<^sub>R f x) \<le> e * content k"
  proof -
    fix x k
    assume xk: "(x,k) \<in> p"
    have "norm (f x) \<le> e"
      using assms(2) tag_in[OF xk] by blast
    then show "norm (content k *\<^sub>R f x) \<le> e * content k"
      using content_pos_le[of k]
      sledgehammer
  qed

  have triangle:
    "norm (\<Sum>(x,k)\<in>p. content k *\<^sub>R f x) \<le>
      (\<Sum>(x,k)\<in>p. norm (content k *\<^sub>R f x))"
    using fin
    sledgehammer

  have sum_bound:
    "(\<Sum>(x,k)\<in>p. norm (content k *\<^sub>R f x)) \<le>
      (\<Sum>(x,k)\<in>p. e * content k)"
    using term_bound
    sledgehammer

  have total:
    "(\<Sum>(x,k)\<in>p. e * content k) = e * content (cbox a b)"
    using additive_content_tagged_division[OF p]
    sledgehammer

  show ?thesis
    using triangle sum_bound total by linarith
qed
